ctu2.sentence: The claim process requires submission of relevant documents.

ctu1.sentence: The application must be submitted to the local fisheries department office.

ctu2.sentence: The insurance coverage is provided through selected insurance companies.

ctu1.sentence: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Fisheries under the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying.

ctu2.sentence: The PMMSY aims to increase fish production to 22 million metric tons by 2024-2025.
